## What changed

First release of the fork, cut from upstream `0.12.2` at `65d2f5b`.

Three fork-owned capabilities land together, each as a new module reaching
upstream code through an import and one registration line.

- **Diátaxis modes** — `lat check mode` validates a document against the mode
  its directory or `lat: mode:` frontmatter declares. Tutorials need ordered
  steps and a stated outcome, how-to guides need ordered steps, reference must
  not carry narrative prose, explanation must not give commands.
- **The comment convention** — a `PreToolUse` gate refuses an edit that writes
  a multi-line rationale comment and tells the agent to put the reasoning in
  `lat.md/` behind an `@lat:` pointer. A `PostToolUse` reminder covers the
  hosts that have no per-edit gate.
- **Knowledge federation** — section `tags:` pull related knowledge from `cq`,
  `bd` memories, and Claude Code memory into the `UserPromptSubmit` payload.
- **YAML frontmatter and untrusted-text quoting** — frontmatter is parsed
  rather than pattern-matched, and repository text placed in front of a model
  is fenced.

Distribution is a GitHub Release plus a Claude Code plugin marketplace; there
is no npm package at this version.
